title: Ended up in a place from my dreamworld in real life… decided to finally post about it.
content: TLDR: I’m sorry it’s long. I went to a place from my dream world in real life, unexpectedly. I don’t post/interact on Reddit really but I’ve been in this group for a long time and enjoy looking at other peoples maps, AI mock ups, and reading your stories. So I’m gunna be brave and post mine! Here is my experience. I wrote this back in August. Have been debating posting this ever since: Aug 14, 2025: Im visiting Ireland for the first time ever. It’s only the second time I’ve traveled internationally. I’ve been staying out in the country. I tried to take a nap earlier today as it’s vacation after all, but I kept hearing the sound of a woman’s voice singing “time to go north” and as I would wake up from it, her voice would blend into the hum of the fan we have working overtime for us. It happened three times before I gave up and got up. My husband and I were restless at the hotel property and asked the front desk where the nearest “downtown area” was, no matter how small. We just wanted to stretch our legs and eat some local food and maybe pop into a pub. She off the rip said Athy was the closest town area. Not much to look at or do but it is a place to go, she said. So we called a taxi and took a ten minute ride north. It was a normal taxi ride, I was staring out the window. As we went down the hill to veer onto the Main Street I was instantly thwarted into my own dream world. I was absolutely stunned by how familiar it is to me. Not like “oh this looks like [insert place I’ve been to before]” it was like, “I’ve been here before, several times,” and it looks exactly like a place in my dreams… I’m gunna try to not flip flop between dream and reality as much as possible but I’m certain, beyond all doubt, that this was the place I dreamt of. I remember in my dreams there always being some type of festival here, there was live music, some kind of celebration, streets full of people, and I remember in my dreams it mainly happening on the Main Street area and then also at the end of a row of colorful houses that led to a field and other areas of the town and was a street over from the main stretch. In the most recent dream in this place I was looking for a store that sells cigarettes… I was coming from the row of colorful houses, walked down onto the Main Street to get a drink and hunt down nicotine, got a call from my friend to meet him at the bridge, so turned back and I went up some stone steps and up a road hill to this old ass bridge that overlooked some tracks but also had a good view to some aspect of the festivities. Maybe it was fireworks? A parade? Idk, the plots of my dreams are the hazy parts. It’s the places I remember most, bc I often go to the same places over and over again. I think I’ve been to this place in my dreams at least three times. Every time it’s a bunch of people and a festival of some sort, it’s at dusk and into the evening, and I’m carefree here. Back to the real world: I was in shock, frantically squirming in my seat to look around as we drove down the Main Street area. Feeling self conscious and desperate to not look like a dumb ass American tourist, I collected myself quickly. Trying to keep cool. I didn’t want to look like a maniac and start word vomiting to this sweet taxi driver and my husband in the way I am right now while writing this. But I was in complete disbelief having a mini existential crisis. The taxi driver drove us to Emily Square and let us out there since he said it’s the central area. We ended up walking in the opposite direction from the specific area I recognized instantly, but to no demise. We walked over a bridge and looked out over the water, and I just had this uncanny feeling of like existing here already, in a way where I’m recalling another life, in the way people say “oh that was lifetimes ago”, like I had nostalgia for this place I’ve never been to in my fucking life. And I ended up here by chance, on someone else’s recommendation. I convinced my husband to walk all up and down the street with me aimlessly. The grade of the land, the strip of shops and pubs—just like my dream world. The strip is populated, as in, kids playing in the river bank (it’s a heat wave to them, after all, even though this feels like fall to me) some folks walking around, cars driving through, people on bikes, but a lot of the storefronts are boarded up/empty/closed for the day, though the buildings themselves beautiful, historic, quaint and colorful with tons of individual character. There are wheat pasted posters on many of the empty buildings detailing some kind of festival. I had chills the whole time I was there. It was bizarre. I felt for the first time like I have actually found a place of my dream world. The oddest part, maybe the nail in the coffin, is the first place my husband and I went to was a pub called The Duke, and we only went there as a second option, looking for food, to no avail, so we sat and he had a beer and I had my first N.A. draft. The bartender was kind, definitely clocked us as foreigners (not hard to do tbh). We sat at the corner of the bar near the entrance. I could feel this old man staring at me from the back right corner since I’d walked in the place. Minutes later, he walked across the pub and approached me, very kindly, leaned over and said, “Hello Miss, don’t you know John Brendan?” (I think that’s the name he said, but idk, I was caught off guard, exhausted, and he had a thick Irish accent. I said “I’m sorry?” He says, “John Brendan (?), from down the street?” I said politely, “No, I’m sorry I don’t.” Maybe he was clocking my accent, but he had his phone out as if to make a call, or show me something, I’m not sure. But he looked at me so utterly confused, almost in disbelief. He said, “are you sure?” And I said yes, and right as I was about to ask “Why?”, he quickly said excuse me and walked away briskly. I watched him walk off back to his seat, now turned away from me, and I was mystified. Sure, maybe he had me confused for someone but I stick out like a sore thumb here, heavily tattooed and not dressed like a local, so I feel like he had to have been nearly convinced of who I was or who I know. Asking me “Are you sure?” Really stuck with me. In hindsight, he reacted how I would react if I thought someone was bold faced lying to me, or if I was extremely embarrassed. But I can’t imagine an innocent mix up being so mortifying that you have to abruptly ditch the conversation without explanation (lol)… and in saying that I don’t apply rudeness on his end at all. Just peculiar and interesting considering the circumstances. ——- That’s the end of what I wrote. Afterwards I definitely stayed up that night thinking about this and pulled up google maps to reassure myself I wasn’t crazy… kinda quizzing myself on where I remembered things being in my dreams and then fact checking myself with the maps. Everything is where I remembered from my dreams, except the area where the main festivities took place looks like a walled off/fenced off on google maps. Definitely freaked myself out a bit doing that. Definitely told my husband over breakfast the next morning all for him to stare at me completely confused. Idk, felt it was all a bit validating if anything. Anyway hope you enjoyed my rant! I might get self conscious and delete it. Edit: typo
